query: What numeric thresholds and decision rules will map detector confidences to confirmed/probable/heuristic labels, and how will we measure precision, recall, and false-positive rates at file and package levels?

response.query: What numeric thresholds and decision rules will map detector confidences to confirmed/probable/heuristic labels, and how will we measure precision, recall, and false-positive rates at file and package levels?
response.answer: Detector confidences map to confirmed/probable/heuristic labels at thresholds of 90%, 70%, and 50%, respectively. Precision, recall, and false-positive rates are measured using confusion matrices at file and package levels. Evaluations are conducted quarterly.
